title: SAS Reporting Specialist
full_description:
City of Taguig, Philippines
Non-Financial Risk Specialist
Background on what ING is about (Generic ING background):
ING Hubs Philippines (ING Hubs PH) is an international part of the ING organization delivering services to many Business Units across the world for both Wholesale Banking and Retail Banking activities. Working for ING Hubs PH means working with the most diverse workforce and where no challenge is the same.
At ING our purpose is to empower people to stay a step ahead in life and business. We believe that sustainable progress is driven by people with the imagination and determination to make a better future for themselves and those around them.
ING is changing what banking is. For you, that means plenty of opportunities for personal growth in a continuously evolving environment. If this is the environment you thrive in, then apply and join us in changing the future of banking!
SAS Reporting Specialistis part of a support team (“NFR Services”) in ING Hubs Manila to help the second line of defense Non-Financial Risk (“NFR”) function to manage the risks associated with people, process, systems etc.  The role is focused on delivering services to ING locations that involve data checks, trend analysis, user training, reporting and system gatekeeping.  The role is critical to the team in supporting the Leads to manage the day-to-day operations and optimizing resources to expand the scope of work and add more value to stakeholders.  NFR Services team is administered locally in ING Hubs Manila under Risk, Compliance and Control Hub Organization and functionally steered by Global NFR in The Netherlands.  NFR Specialist will be interacting mainly with local NFR managers in ING branches and users of NFR system.
SAS Reporting Specialist will be expected to perform a combination of the following activities (as service to NFR Managers and NFR system users across ING locations):
Incident (Events) Reporting - involved in monitoring reporting of events by businesses and ensuring data is sufficient for further assessment of Non-Financial Risk Managers
Issue and Action Tracking – involved in registration and amendment of findings (issues) in iRisk, monitoring status and escalating issue data for further assessment of Non-Financial Risk Managers
Key Risk Indicator (KRI) Reporting – coordinate the regular reporting of KRI data and validating details and supporting documents provided by the business
NFR Information Pack -   prepare and provide monthly and quarterly NFR dashboard reports for each branch / location
Management of NFR system - ensure accuracy and completeness of risk data stored in the risk system. As needed by ING NFR system users, perform user access management activities, provide training to end users, answer queries, validate or map risk data and objects, make bulk data amendments, setting up or data structure for countries or cleaning up data for control frameworks.
Regulatory event reporting – system generation, analysis and reporting of Non-Financial risk events and related information necessary for internal business use and European Central Bank purposes
Maintenance of tools and documentations used in the above processes including capturing, analyzing and executing changes related to them
In line with delivering the services, SAS Reporting Specialist will collaborate with a dynamic team of 15 people and internal and external stakeholders on the following operational activities:
Facilitate discussions with stakeholders
Conduct internal quality checks
Perform root cause analysis and address service delivery issues
Organize, coordinate and document projects within the team or a wider group
Guide more junior or less tenured colleagues
Gather, analyze and visualize data needed for business or management decision making
Any other responsibility essential to the functioning of the team, department or ING as discussed and agreed with the Leads
Key Capabilities/Experience
Highly interested to grow career in Non-Financial Risk management
Has worked in a bank doing functions like reporting, application support, risk management or a combination of these
Tech savvy – experience in creating or using tools like PowerBI, Cognos or SAS
Knows how to capture, document and execute process and system changes
Has worked with global teams and able to present to senior stakeholders
Minimum Qualifications
At least 5 years total work experience in banking or financial services
At least 2 years of working with SAS in reporting or coding responsibilities
Willing to do both reporting and system user support activities
With formal training in SAS scripting or willing to learn how to code programs
Having a Business analyst background is an advantage
Knows to interpret, visualize and present data for a large or international audience
With strong communication and organization skills
